notes.title: First release in Early Access
notes.content:
It's almost time, from 2/20/23 you can play The Hero's Journey through Time.
At the time of release, 3 worlds will be playable, one of which is a "Secret", world 4 is currently only accessible at the "world spawn".

Of the 4 worlds, you can enter 3 at any time (with the teleportation device).

Unfortunately English will follow later because of the lack of translators

Regards: ~ Wuppi
